title: Privacy notice and terms of use
privacy: Kapibo is a free, open-source app developed on a non-professional, non-profit basis by Marketto (github.com/Marketto, marco.ricupero@gmail.com). The developer does not receive, see or store the data you enter in the app: for this data the developer is not a data controller. When you use the app for your household budget, processing takes place on your device for purely personal and household purposes (Art. 2(2)(c) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679, “GDPR”). For any privacy question you can write to the address above or open an issue at github.com/Marketto/Kapibo.

a) Data you enter or that the app reads from documents you choose: amounts, categories, dates, notes, income, balances, meal vouchers, meter readings, bills, text recognised from receipts, payslips, bank statements and bills. It may include financial data about you or your family. b) App settings (language, theme, currency) and, if you connect a cloud or advanced reading, the related access codes. c) Technical browsing data (IP address, browser type, date and time of requests) that hosting and file-delivery providers receive when you open the app, as with any website.
3. How and where it is processed

Photos and PDFs are read on your device by the text-recognition engine and are neither saved nor sent. Data stays in your device's browser storage (IndexedDB and localStorage). These technologies are strictly necessary to run the app you requested and are not used to track you, so they do not require consent (Art. 5(3) of Directive 2002/58/EC and national implementing laws). The app uses no profiling cookies, advertising or analytics tools.

a) Running the app and the features you choose: performance of the terms of use you accept (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). b) Hosting and site security (technical logs): the providers' legitimate interest in protecting their services (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). c) Sync with Dropbox or Google Drive and advanced reading with Claude: only active if you decide so, by connecting the service or entering your own key, and you can turn them off at any time.

No data is passed to the developer or sold. Data may reach only these providers, acting as independent controllers under their own privacy policies: GitHub (Microsoft), which hosts the app at marketto.github.io and logs visitors' IP addresses for security; jsDelivr, used only if some reading-engine files are unavailable on marketto.github.io; Dropbox and Google, only if you connect your account, to store the copy of your data; Anthropic, only if you enter your own API key, which receives the text read from receipts (never the photos).

The providers listed may process data in the United States or other non-EU countries. According to their privacy policies, transfers rely on the EU-US adequacy decision (Data Privacy Framework, Decision (EU) 2023/1795) or on standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission (Arts. 45 and 46 GDPR). You can avoid any transfer by not connecting external services.

Data on the device stays until you delete it (More › Delete all data) or clear the browser data. The cloud copy stays until you delete it from your account. Providers' technical logs follow the periods in their policies. The developer keeps nothing.

You have the rights under Articles 15 to 22 GDPR: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection. For data on the device you exercise them directly in the app (edit, export, delete); for data held by providers you contact them. You can withdraw optional choices at any time by disconnecting the service. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the data protection authority of the country where you live or work (in Italy: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali, garanteprivacy.it).
9. Whether data is required, and automated decisions

You are not required to enter any data: without data the app simply shows no calculations. Categories, tips and the mascot's phrases are suggestions generated on your device: there are no automated decisions producing legal effects concerning you (Art. 22 GDPR).
Data is accessible to anyone who can use your device and browser. Protect your device with a screen lock, do not use the app on shared devices and keep exported backups safe.
The app is intended for adults managing their household budget.

If this notice changes, the app will show it to you again before you continue. Any future usage statistics will be anonymous, optional, off until you turn them on, and described here before being introduced.

Italian law applies. If you are a consumer, the mandatory rules of your country of residence and the jurisdiction of the courts of your place of residence or domicile remain unaffected.
For reports or complaints: marco.ricupero@gmail.com or github.com/Marketto/Kapibo.
summary: Free, open source, no ads, no tracking.
Your data stays on your device and, only if you choose, in your cloud: the developer never receives it.
Automatic reading can make mistakes: always check your data.
Not financial advice and no warranty: you use the app at your own risk, within the limits of the law.
